featured_reviews.name: Komal Shastri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had been wanting to try pottery with friends for a long time, but most places in south bombay are very expensive. this was a relief budget-wise and turned out to be a lot of fun. we booked two slots, where one slot is one hour for two people, giving each person about 30 minutes. I would strongly recommend booking two slots so it doesn’t feel rushed. one instructor was trying to rush us due to crowd pressure and incorrectly said our time was over, but we stuck to our ticket timings and continued. other instructors were friendly and helpful.

the space is small but aesthetically done. weekends can get very crowded, so booking in advance is important. we made four small souvenirs which were not perfect, but that is part of the magic you create. they also host other events like painting and stand-up comedy, which makes it a great creative hub. I would love to see more such affordable experiences around bandra :))

featured_reviews.name: Samuel Ward-Butler
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dorangos in Bandra on the morning of the Friday 15th May 2026. We came here to do some pottery painting as an activity.

The place itself is a little tucked away; but we had a lovely time here! Really good fun.

featured_reviews.name: Dharmaraj Maingade
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for a casual, budget-friendly night out in Bandra, the stand-up shows at Dorangos (located right near Candies in Pali Hill) are a hidden gem. It’s a very intimate, small space, which means you're up close and personal with the comics. Depending on the night, you might catch seasoned locals testing fresh material or enthusiastic upcoming talent.
The best part? The ticket prices are incredibly cheap for Bandra, and they often let you cover the entry fee against food and drinks at their upstairs cafe. The crowd size can be hit-or-miss—sometimes it’s a packed house, and other times it’s just a handful of people—but the cozy layout actually makes the smaller crowds feel like a fun, private hang out session.

featured_reviews.review_text: You’ll never regret visiting this place! I went for a stand-up comedy show and it was amazing. Everything was great — the vibe, the arrangements, and the team was super nice and welcoming. I had a really fun time and would definitely recommend this place to others.

There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

They offered us a range of bottles, glasses and even tubelight with a smashing wall right in front of us. There were hammers as well to channelise your inner Triple H.

We were given 30 minutes to get going. There was a speaker where you could play music with a bluetooth connection. It was so well organised that you didn't have to wait for anything. They also offer you a TV to break if you pay an extra amount.

We didn't have to wait for a long time as we got our slot booked and will advise others to do the same on their website. You can find more about our experience at TheHoggerBloggers on Instagram.

featured_reviews.name: Cherry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Experience the exhilarating shift from tranquility to tumult in Mumbai’s inaugural rage room!
It was one of the best experiences I had in a very long time . I was curious to know how it works but I tell u this was so therapeutic.
Breaking cups glasses on wall  , smashing the bottles with hammer breaking of tube lights it’s a brilliant concept to relief stress !!

They provide a safe environment with proper mask shield , cap, gloves , suit and shoes
You can play your own music during the activity .

You can enjoy this alone , with your friend or group the experience is thrilling !!!

So get ready to Embrace the thrill of swinging, smashing, and releasing pent-up stress – here, stress is powerless
Package :

✅Basic package - 499/-
(Includes 10 beer bottle, 10 balloons, 3 ceramic mugs, 3 tea glasses for 10 minutes)

featured_reviews.name: Hitanshu Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an incredibly lovely concept. You just come in and unload your rage by breaking a delightful assortment of glass.

I highly recommend the 1500+GST package since by the time you get your grip on how to have fun, you are out of bottles.

I would also recommend you to borrow the sanitizer stand to use as a tripod for your videos!

somesh is a great host. Will visit again. He is very kind and friendly.

This is in a minor alley and up a flight of stairs but without any markings. Just ask the building guard if you feel lost

The air conditioning was terrible in my visit. Strongly suggest that you ask them to start it while they prep the room for you! Very annoying but somesh is a great host.

Please avoid wearing glasses because the face shields have a tendency to fog up given how excited we get. Please wear contact lenses if you can. Else they have a lovely Darth Vader mask for folks with spectacles.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Rage Room Mumbai with a friend, and what an experience it was!😍 Located conveniently near Sakinaka Metro Station, this place offers the perfect outlet to vent out all your frustration and anger. The setup is great, with various items to smash and destroy.😄 The staff were friendly and ensured our safety throughout. It was incredibly therapeutic and left us feeling refreshed. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a unique way to release stress!👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: bhavna varshney
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an incredible experience at the Rage Room! From the moment I stepped in, the staff made me feel comfortable and explained everything clearly.

The safety gear was top-notch, and the variety of items available to smash was impressive. It was such a unique and exhilarating way to release stress and let go of built-up tension.

The environment is well-maintained, and the entire session felt both safe and therapeutic.

Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a fun and effective way to blow off some steam! Can't wait to come back again!

featured_reviews.name: Yashika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: We went to rage room , it was had hour slot ang omg it was totally worth it . We broke all the bottles cups tubelight  and had so much fun with full safety 😍 would definitely recommend going after exams 😂

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Khakhrodia
featured_reviews.review_text: Game Palacio Kurla is a must-visit. It successfully merges a luxury lounge with a high-octane gaming zone. If you want a day filled with "games, arcade, good food, and drinks," this is easily one of the best spots in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Ajish Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: We Hosted our company party at Game Palacio Kurla location and it was an absolute blast! The atmosphere was vibrant and the perfect mix of competition and socializing. The gaming area was fantastic—our team loved specific bowling/arcade. Huge shoutout to Ms. Namrata who helped us through out the event and the staff for keeping the drinks flowing and the energy high. The food was surprisingly great for a gaming venue, especially fish finger. Highly recommend for a fun, stress-free team event!!!

featured_reviews.name: Harshvardhan kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: It was our first time for Bowling. There is no prior reservation required it is first come first serve basis. Since it was weekend we were charged 500+ taxes with buy one get one offer and this offer is from morning uptil 4 PM, 20 balls each player. It was a fun experience though and you can visit with ur friends here. On one bowling track four players can play together. There is screen above which tells u about score among players. There are other games too and for which u need to pay different charges. There is attached resto- bar where you can enjoy meal( it has its own menu and need to pay according to menu). Overall it was an amazing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Krishna Madhwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Instead of politely informing us about last order timings, the approach was pushy and disrespectful.

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: LM Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: In case one wants to enjoy good music, food and bowling alley all at one place, this is the place. Great crowd. Alcohol, cocktails and mocktail are served. Waiting for your chance of bowling may take up to an hour during weekends.

customer_updates.text:
An absolutely thrilling and immersive F1 driving simulator experience! Prats has truly channeled years of racing expertise into crafting India’s most authentic F1 cockpit. Every turn delivers the electrifying sensation of G-Force, making it a must-try for motorsport enthusiasts. Whether you're a rookie looking to speed through Circuit Gilles Villeneuve (Montreal) or a seasoned pro eager to master the intricate details of Circuit de Monaco (Monte Carlo) with a fully functional F1 steering wheel, this simulator offers it all.

Beyond racing, their extensive VR game library caters to everyone—from action-packed shooting games to cricket and even intriguing mystery rooms. Perfect for outings with friends, family, or corporate events, this place is an absolute gem. Don’t miss it!

featured_reviews.name: Chintan Talati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried our (me + 2 college friends) hands at both the F1 sim and VR games today. Although at middle age our reaction times weren't as good, but we enjoyed the full experience.

Meenal was a great help and a good host, explained us the basics before we get in the game.

They have 3 F1 sims and I would recommend a larger 6+ member group to enjoy larger maps.

One caveat, the F1 sim isn't available in vs mode and the VR isn't available in co-op mode.

All in all, if this is your first time you will surely be thrilled!!

featured_reviews.name: Rds Hogger
featured_reviews.review_text:
Where screen time meets real adrenaline.

F1 racing, VR gaming & nonstop action, all in one place.

Your squad’s next obsession starts here. 👀

featured_reviews.name: Brinale Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience and fun time here playing f1 Sim racing. It was a surprise for my bf's bday who is a Sim racer and f1 enthusiast and he really enjoyed. Also they went out of their way to create a special birthday wall projection with our pics and a message from their side, which was very sweet as a gesture. Highly recommend checking them out!

featured_reviews.name: krithika shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I would definitely recommend visiting this placs with your gang to have fun in an competitive environment.  Great team, and good equipments that enhance the experience. Strongly recommend to do both VR and F1 to get the best value experience. Thanks medusa and the team 😃

featured_reviews.name: Srinivas Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing VR experience in Mumbai!

Parabolica VR is one of the most exciting and immersive gaming experiences I’ve had. The setup is modern, the VR quality is excellent, and the simulations feel very realistic.

The staff are friendly, helpful, and guide you well even if you are trying VR for the first time, ours was first time. The ambience is energetic and perfect for friends, family outings, or even team activities.

Overall, a fun, unique, and well-managed place — definitely worth visiting if you want something different from the usual entertainment options in Mumbai.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text: Driving the F1 simulator at Parabolica was one of my best experience behind the wheel. Haptic feedbacks were great and on point. The TV screen felt a little bit choppy while playing due to low FPS, you won't notice it if you aren't into gaming. The host was kind and knowledgeable and helped us throughout our session. We also tried the VR game and had a lot of fun. Will surely visit once again if I get the opportunity. Overall a fantastic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Maahi Chitre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had such a fun time at Parabolica Social Gaming!

Tried both the VR and the motion-based F1 simulator and honestly, it was such a different experience. The VR felt super real and the staff guided us properly on how to play, which made it even better.

The F1 simulator was the highlight for me  it actually moves and feels like you’re on a real track, which was insane 😭🏎️

Also loved the overall vibe, especially the visual wall, it looks so cool and adds to the whole experience.

Perfect place for a group outing with friends. Would definitely go again! 👯‍♀️✨

featured_reviews.name: Bhakti Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text: Checked out Parabolica recently and it’s easily one of the coolest spots in the Jogeshwari/Andheri West area. The F1 simulators are incredibly realistic—you really feel the haptic feedback on every turn. We also did the free-roam VR, and not being tethered by wires makes a huge difference for movement. Great place to hang out with friends if you're tired of the usual bowling or movies. Staff was super helpful in getting us geared up!

featured_reviews.name: Eric Farrar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Foreigner experience:

First off, the price for a bed here was very very affordable. Perfect for solo budget travelers like myself. However the dormitory is small compared to others so they probably couldn't guarantee 2+ open beds for larger travel groups.

The place is kept clean but be aware if you're looking for spotless luxury white linens you should look somewhere else. The bathrooms were also a little cramped compared to other dormitories I've stayed at. This is from the perspective of 6"5 height. Also the pillow were like sleeping with my head on a rock.

Overall I would recommend. The people staying here were so friendly and helpful too. I really enjoyed the vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Adam Bodhi
featured_reviews.review_text: If you're looking for a good, cheap place to stay that's very close to the airport, this is a good choice. It's very simple, but the sheets are clean, the AC works well, and there is a locker under the bed, so it feels secure too. There's are also plenty of good places to eat nearby. I arrived without booking and before checkin time and only paid R500. I only gave 3 stars because it is quite a simple place.

featured_reviews.name: Jerin J

featured_reviews.name: Daniel Benivegna
featured_reviews.review_text: Coming here during monsoon season, most guests were Indian. This place is literally just beds, and three bathrooms. No toilet paper or soap is included, so be sure to bring your own. There is good wifi and air conditioning, as well as a personal fan in each bunk. A lock box, outlets, shelf, and personal light is also included in each bunk. Breakfast is free and comes in the form of two small jam and toast sandwiches with chai. That is perfect to hold you over until you can get into the city and try all the amazing street foods. Seriously, Mumbai is a city for food lovers. Pretty good value overall. The owner from Kerala is very attentive to guests' needs, and is quite personable. That is to say he is very kind. The boys he has on staff have varying levels of spoken english, but all are friendly and helpful just the same. Would recommend for backpackers on a budget.

featured_reviews.name: Arnav Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Cool place to stay, comfy and cozy place. Service is good and caretaker even took the pain to wake up for me to open the gates at morning 4 AM (as I had to go for walk) . Good stay. The even prepare your bed each morning. Also try out the food at the Chinese corner near the dorm . Sakinaka Metro station is just 200 Mt away. Good review. AC works fine.
